GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: Credential authority is separated from networking because possession, use, renewal, and disclosure have different security consequences and owners.

Alternatives.Alternative: Return a secret after a permission prompt. Rejected because the feature can retain and exfiltrate it after the intended operation or consent window.
Use one account-wide provider token handle. Rejected because it cannot express operation and destination attenuation.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The first operating-system credential-store backend and provider protocol are selected during planning; non-exportability and handle binding remain normative.

Scenarios.Scenario: A feature may ask the broker to execute one read-only provider query but cannot obtain the token or reuse the handle for a write.
A runtime restart invalidates all prior handles while installation-owned account selection remains durable under trusted ownership.
